key_insight: Simulations suggest parameterized annealing-scheduled QAOA (PAQ-QAOA) can approximate restricted Boltzmann machine sampling for the tractable instances studied.
engineering_relevance: QAOA-assisted sampling could support RBM training, but practical benefits over classical sampling remain unestablished.
method: Simulate PAQ-QAOA circuits using Qiskit Aer.
Analyze the inverse effective temperature κ of sampled distributions.
Evaluate Boltzmann sampling at tractable problem sizes.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports numerical evidence from Qiskit Aer simulations, not quantum hardware experiments.
watch_item: Hardware performance, scaling, and circuit-depth requirements for arbitrary problem sizes remain open questions.
paper_title: $κ$-Parametrized Boltzmann Distribution Sampling on Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm
